station-stage.prompt: Paint one clean reusable environment plate for Transport Town, an animation-ready coastal station square in a cheerful premium children's Miniature World style. Wide landscape 3:2 framing, 1536 x 1024. Hand-painted gouache with matte subtle texture on handcrafted miniature architecture, simplified factual geometry, layered greenery, warm cream stone, muted navy, sea turquoise, soft morning light. Camera looks straight across all routes side-on from a modest elevation, orthographic feel. This is an empty set with absolutely NO train, bus, boat, airplane, people, clouds, text, letters, signage text, foreground trees, title, UI or decorative border. Clean road and rails all the way to the frame edges. Layout with these exact visual bands: y=0–27% quiet pale blue sky, y=27–38% low coastal hills with distant sea and a tiny empty horizontal light-grey runway on the far LEFT; y=38–51% calm blue harbour across full width, with a LOW, HORIZONTAL stone quay at y=49–52% and a short walkway landing in the centre-right near x=58%. y=52–65% warm station scene with a neat small cream station house and navy roof on the left and low canopy near centre-right, both BEHIND the track. The TRAIN tracks run perfectly straight, horizontal and unbroken left-to-right at y=65–68%, no perspective convergence or turns; pale passenger platform in front of them at y=68–73%, with a yellow edge. y=75–86% is a straight horizontal dark grey bus street with a road surface across the FULL image. Kerb at y=87%, then warm pedestrian paving to y=95%. Low planted border at the very bottom. Very clean visual separation between sea, platform, rails, street and sidewalk. Keep the middle half usable when the edges are cropped on a phone. Reserve unbroken negative space in the top third for HTML title and Explore. Transport scene will be composited with individual side-view sprites and people. Paint every surface clean behind the actors, and NEVER put any moving subjects into the scenery.
